_comment: Example parameter sets for the HTTP API (POST /api/analyses).
The browser UI builds exactly these payloads; the API is documented here so
the analysis can also be scripted for batch work. Every key not listed is
left at the documented default in app/config.py.
All time values are in SECONDS. All pixel coordinates refer to the original
video resolution, not to whatever the browser happened to display.

zahn_cup_by_click._comment: Simplest Zahn run: click the outlet, take every other default.

_comment: A tuned Zahn run for a dark, low-contrast liquid on a busy background.
flow_end_persistence_s is the value to adjust first when the timing stops
too early (raise it) or drags on after the last drop (lower it).
A whole shift. shortest_event_s drives the scan speed: the scan samples
shortest_event_s / safety_factor apart, so 20 s here means one sample
every ~6.7 s and roughly 6 500 samples for 12 hours.
